content:
Vanessa Tavares, Head of Sustainability at BUILT CoLAB, took part in the working group meeting and 3rd meeting of the management committee of the COST CircularB action, which took place between 11 and 13 September in Istanbul, Turkey.

The aim of this event was to discuss the work carried out so far by the different players, as well as to plan future actions. In this context, BUILT CoLAB was responsible for leading the realisation of task T1.8. entitled ‘Development of simulation models through BIM with circularity options to predict future scenarios and identify potential trade-off possibilities’.

Remember that a COST action is an interdisciplinary research network that brings together researchers and innovators to investigate a topic of their choice for four years. These meetings and encounters are a way for BUILT CoLAB to continue contributing to innovation for more circular construction, while maintaining contacts with an international network of experts on the subject.

Information about this CircularB action is available here.
